audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Vayne levels 2-3 and called 4-5 and 6 even; the mirror audit (karma__vayne) settled the chart as Karma x3 then Vayne x4.
audit.why: Karma has Mantra available at level 1 with no skill point, and Inner Flame reaches 950 vs Vayne's 550 Condemn / auto range, so the first three levels are hers. Vayne takes over once Silver Bolts true damage beats Karma's thin base defenses.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side and win[0..2] = Karma; phases[3..6].side and win[3..6] = Vayne, proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0]/spikes[1] and the level-6 phase text claimed Karma has 'no hard CC' and that 6 is even.
audit.why: Focused Resolve (W) is a root — the kit flags hardCC and the description says the enemy is rooted if the tether is not broken — on a flat 12s cooldown at every rank. Level 6 favours Vayne: Final Hour grants stealth during Tumble plus a reduced Tumble cooldown, while Mantra only empowers one existing spell.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0], spikes[1], phases[4].why, early and mid around Focused Resolve's real 12s/675 root and Final Hour's stealth Tumble.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] said Focused Resolve slows; breakdown.cooldowns carried no real numbers.
audit.why: Focused Resolve roots and reveals (it also answers stealth, which matters against Final Hour); the slow in Karma's kit is on Inner Flame and Mantra. Condemn is 20s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5; Final Hour is 100/85/70.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] changed to 'Root you with Focused Resolve (W)'; breakdown.cooldowns now carries 12s/675 on W, Condemn's 20s->12s, and Final Hour's 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds note anywhere, despite the flagged missing interaction.
audit.why: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma and extends the root, so extended trades swing on anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: Added Grievous Wounds to report[8].t itemization.

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill matchup: it hinges on whether you dodge Inner Flame.
edits.after: Level 1 favours Karma: Mantra is up at level 1 and Inner Flame outranges you.

edits.before: Level 2 favours you: no CC to stop you walking her down for Silver Bolts stacks.
edits.after: Level 2 favours Karma: Focused Resolve roots you if you fail to break its tether.

edits.before: Level 3 favours you: you punish her long Mantra cooldown with Tumble trades.
edits.after: Level 3 favours Karma: her 950-range poke beats your 550 range until items.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 favour you: Silver Bolts true damage wins any trade she stays in.

edits.before: Karma is a low-threat lane bully with no hard CC; kite her Inner Flame and stack Silver Bolts once RQ Mantra poke is on cooldown.
edits.after: Karma roots with Focused Resolve (W), a flat 12s tether at 675 range that breaks on distance; step out, then stack Silver Bolts.

edits.before: Karma's ult only empowers existing spells: she has no burst combo to kill you, so 6 is roughly even and you keep out-DPSing.
edits.after: Mantra (R) only empowers one spell, so there is no burst combo, while Final Hour hides your Tumble and cuts its cooldown.

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill check around dodging Karma's Inner Flame (Q): sidestep it with Tumble and the lane opens up immediately. She has no reliable hard CC and mediocre base defenses, so once you are level 2-3 you walk her down and stack Silver Bolts freely. Bait her Mantra-Q poke, then punish the long Mantra cooldown with a Tumble-auto trade. Only the Focused Resolve (W) tether threatens you, and it breaks on range.
edits.after: Karma has Mantra up at level 1, so Inner Flame (Q) pokes from 950 range before you can answer at 550 — sidestep it with Tumble and take the CS you can get. Focused Resolve (W) is real hard CC on a flat 12s: it roots you when the tether holds, so break line of sight or leave its 675 range. Once W is spent, walk her down and stack Silver Bolts; her base defenses are thin.

edits.before: Through mid-lane you keep the edge whenever her shield and Mantra are down. Level 6 is even because Karma's ult just refreshes her existing kit, so there is no execute combo to fear and you keep trading on cooldowns. Respect the RW root-slow if her jungler is nearby, but in a straight 1v1 your DPS wins. Freeze and deny her roam windows.
edits.after: Through mid-lane you keep the edge whenever Inspire (E) and Mantra are down. Level 6 goes your way: Mantra empowers one spell with no execute, while Final Hour hides your Tumble and cuts its cooldown. Respect Mantra-W's extended root if her jungler is nearby, but in a straight 1v1 your DPS wins. Freeze and deny her roam windows.

edits.before: Slow you with Focused Resolve (W)
edits.after: Root you with Focused Resolve (W)

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Karma contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Karma has Mantra at level 1 and 950 range on Inner Flame — she pokes for free. Take safe CS and learn her Q rhythm.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Karma's Focused Resolve is down.
edits.after: Focused Resolve is up now: a 12s root on a 675 tether. Step in only once she spends it or you can break range.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but her poke still outranges you. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into Condemn range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Focused Resolve's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' third-hit true damage now beats her thin base defenses: trade around Focused Resolve's flat 12s and bank small leads.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Final Hour's stealth Tumbles and its reduced Tumble cooldown break her poke pattern. Mantra empowers a spell but gives her no kill combo.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — a flat 12s root tether at 675 range; break line of sight and it never completes. - Condemn: 20s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — spend it on a wall. - Final Hour: 100s, kill windows only.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot vs the poke. Core: Blade of the Ruined King  (%HP + the duel spike), then Phantom Dancer; boots Mercury's Treads.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield vs the poke. Core: Blade of the Ruined King, then Phantom Dancer; boots Mercury's Treads. Mantra-W heals her — get Grievous Wounds.
